**Yes—in principle.** If “filling in the bottom of the spine bone map” changes which pixels are included in the DXA analysis region, it can change the measured bone mineral content and projected area, and therefore the reported areal BMD. The size and direction of any change depend on the specific image and boundary.

I did not find a direct study quantifying the effect of this particular map-filling inconsistency, so this is a methodological conclusion, not a quantified estimate of its impact. Inconsistent analysis may reduce comparability between scans; review the original image and analysis boundaries before interpreting a small BMD change.
